claim_text: Shared genus spaces are authoritative after no-parent-plus-descendant double counting and sample reclosure before CLR.
Microbiome-only is the principal directly transportable molecular analysis; metabolome-only and early integration are assay-scale stress tests.
Do not claim metabolomics is quantitatively transportable across cohorts; v2c Branch B found no defensible common-scale matrix locally.
MOFA is descriptive, unsupervised structural integration; sCCA tuning-fold correlations are diagnostics and full-data correlations are apparent.
Do not claim causal mechanisms, covariate independence or external prediction from MOFA/sCCA.
NJC19 edges are curated production, consumption or transport relations; primary graph is unsigned and undirected.
Do not call NJC19 edges positive statistical associations or treat graph connectivity as predictive utility.
Use ensemble participant-level OOF performance, participant bootstrap CIs and paired participant bootstrap differences.
Do not average fold AUC as the headline result, treat seeds as independent, claim clinical prediction, or run external Stage 4E transfer.
